package availability

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/sha1"
	"crypto/x509"
	"encoding/json"
	"encoding/pem"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/Azure/azqr/internal/scanners/plugins/region/types"
	"github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-go/sdk/azcore"
	"github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-go/sdk/azcore/arm"
	"github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-go/sdk/azcore/policy"
	"github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-go/sdk/resourcemanager/resources/armresources"
)

const providerSubscription = "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111"
const providerAudience = "https://provider.capture.invalid"
const providerPath = "/subscriptions/" + providerSubscription + "/providers"
const providerStart = providerPath + "?api-version=2021-04-01"

type providerCaptureCredential struct {
	t *testing.T
	scope string
}

func (c providerCaptureCredential) GetToken(ctx context.Context, options policy.TokenRequestOptions) (azcore.AccessToken, error) {
	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return azcore.AccessToken{}, err
	}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(options.Scopes, []string{c.scope}) {
		c.t.Fatal("provider synthetic audience mismatch")
	}
	return azcore.AccessToken{Token: "synthetic-provider-canary", ExpiresOn: time.Now().Add(time.Hour)}, nil
}

type providerCapturePage struct {
	Status int
	Body string
}

type providerCaptureCase struct {
	Pages []providerCapturePage
	Cancelled bool
	CycleLimit int
	CancelAfter int
}

type providerCaptureResult struct {
	Cache *types.ResourceTypeLocationData
	Failed bool
	Panicked bool
	Requests []string
	RawRequestURIs []string
	CallerRows []types.RegionComparison
	CallerPanicked bool
	CallerRequests []string
	CallerRawRequestURIs []string
}

type providerCaptureFixture struct {
	t *testing.T
	mu sync.Mutex
	current providerCaptureCase
	requests []string
	raw []string
	base string
	cancel context.CancelFunc
}

func (f *providerCaptureFixture) ServeHTTP(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	f.mu.Lock()
	defer f.mu.Unlock()
	f.requests = append(f.requests, r.Method+" "+providerAudience+r.URL.String())
	f.raw = append(f.raw, r.RequestURI)
	i := len(f.requests)-1
	if r.Method != "GET" || r.Header.Get("Authorization") != "Bearer synthetic-provider-canary" || (r.Body != nil && r.ContentLength != 0) {
		f.t.Error("unexpected provider synthetic method/body/token")
		http.Error(w, "synthetic request tripwire", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	if r.URL.Path != providerPath || r.URL.Query().Get("api-version") != "2021-04-01" || r.URL.Query().Has("$expand") {
		f.t.Error("unexpected provider synthetic path/query")
		http.Error(w, "synthetic path tripwire", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	if f.current.CycleLimit > 0 && i >= f.current.CycleLimit {
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusBadRequest)
		_, _ = io.WriteString(w, "{\"error\":{\"code\":\"SyntheticCycleStopped\",\"message\":\"synthetic\"}}")
		return
	}
	if f.current.CycleLimit == 0 && i >= len(f.current.Pages) {
		f.t.Error("unexpected provider synthetic page request")
		http.Error(w, "synthetic page tripwire", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	pageIndex := i
	if f.current.CycleLimit > 0 {
		pageIndex = 0
	}
	p := f.current.Pages[pageIndex]
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.WriteHeader(p.Status)
	_, _ = io.WriteString(w, strings.ReplaceAll(p.Body, "@BASE@", f.base))
	if f.current.CancelAfter > 0 && i+1 == f.current.CancelAfter {
		f.cancel()
	}
}

func (f *providerCaptureFixture) reset(c providerCaptureCase, cancel context.CancelFunc) {
	f.mu.Lock()
	defer f.mu.Unlock()
	f.current = c
	f.cancel = cancel
	f.requests = []string{}
	f.raw = []string{}
}

func (f *providerCaptureFixture) observations() ([]string, []string) {
	f.mu.Lock()
	defer f.mu.Unlock()
	return append([]string{}, f.requests...), append([]string{}, f.raw...)
}

type providerPublicTransport struct {
	t *testing.T
	requests []string
}

func (f *providerPublicTransport) Do(r *http.Request) (*http.Response, error) {
	want := "https://management.azure.com"+providerStart
	if r.Method != "GET" || r.URL.String() != want || r.Body != nil || r.Header.Get("Authorization") != "Bearer synthetic-provider-canary" {
		f.t.Fatal("unexpected public SDK provider request")
	}
	f.requests = append(f.requests, r.Method+" "+r.URL.String())
	return &http.Response{StatusCode: http.StatusOK, Header: http.Header{"Content-Type": []string{"application/json"}}, Body: io.NopCloser(strings.NewReader("{\"value\":[]}")), Request: r}, nil
}

func providerCaptureBlob(t *testing.T, path, want string) {
	t.Helper()
	raw, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	hash := sha1.Sum(append([]byte(fmt.Sprintf("blob %d\x00", len(raw))), raw...))
	if fmt.Sprintf("%x", hash) != want {
		t.Fatal("provider source blob mismatch", path)
	}
}

func TestRegionProviderLocationsCapture(t *testing.T) {
	output := os.Getenv("REGION_PROVIDER_LOCATIONS_CAPTURE_OUTPUT")
	if output == "" {
		t.Fatal("missing provider capture output")
	}
	providerCaptureBlob(t, "availability.go", "55e59b9e061dd31d27cc3446ad00659bd6961174")
	providerCaptureBlob(t, "../types/types.go", "f9b61fb74075e5a2297be1b898067b8cb047f9b3")
	providerCaptureBlob(t, "../../../../az/client_options.go", "73693e3730f5ed51132a552b79d5e95078721a10")
	providerCaptureBlob(t, "../../../../az/cred.go", "9677ae498c8d22ebbc77a1fe3a47e17579f3c4d5")
	fixture := &providerCaptureFixture{t: t}
	server := httptest.NewTLSServer(fixture)
	defer server.Close()
	fixture.base = server.URL
	pemBytes := pem.EncodeToMemory(&pem.Block{Type: "CERTIFICATE", Bytes: server.Certificate().Raw})
	certFile := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "fixture.pem")
	if err := os.WriteFile(certFile, pemBytes, 0600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Setenv("SSL_CERT_FILE", certFile)
	t.Setenv("SSL_CERT_DIR", t.TempDir())
	t.Setenv("AZURE_AUTHORITY_HOST", "https://authority.capture.invalid/")
	t.Setenv("AZURE_RESOURCE_MANAGER_ENDPOINT", server.URL)
	t.Setenv("AZURE_RESOURCE_MANAGER_AUDIENCE", providerAudience)
	t.Setenv("AZURE_CLOUD", "")
	t.Setenv("HTTP_PROXY", "")
	t.Setenv("HTTPS_PROXY", "")
	t.Setenv("ALL_PROXY", "")
	t.Setenv("NO_PROXY", "")
	roots, err := x509.SystemCertPool()
	wantRoots := x509.NewCertPool()
	if err != nil || !wantRoots.AppendCertsFromPEM(pemBytes) || !roots.Equal(wantRoots) {
		t.Fatal("provider fixture trust is not restricted to its certificate")
	}
	if _, err = server.Certificate().Verify(x509.VerifyOptions{Roots: roots, DNSName: "127.0.0.1"}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal("provider loopback certificate verification failed")
	}
	public := &providerPublicTransport{t: t, requests: []string{}}
	client, err := armresources.NewProvidersClient(providerSubscription, providerCaptureCredential{t, "https://management.core.windows.net//.default"}, &arm.ClientOptions{
		ClientOptions: policy.ClientOptions{Transport: public, Retry: policy.RetryOptions{MaxRetries: -1}},
		DisableRPRegistration: true,
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if _, err = client.NewListPager(nil).NextPage(context.Background()); err != nil || len(public.requests) != 1 {
		t.Fatal("public SDK provider request fixture failed")
	}
	row := func(namespace, resourceType string, locations any) string {
		b, err := json.Marshal(map[string]any{"namespace": namespace, "resourceTypes": []any{map[string]any{"resourceType": resourceType, "locations": locations}}})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		return string(b)
	}
	envelope := func(rows ...string) string { return "{\"value\":[" + strings.Join(rows, ",") + "]}" }
	one := func(body string) providerCaptureCase { return providerCaptureCase{Pages: []providerCapturePage{{200, body}}} }
	vm := func(locations any) string { return row("Microsoft.Compute", "virtualMachines", locations) }
	next := "@BASE@" + providerStart + "&$skiptoken=synthetic-second"
	page := func(body string) string { return strings.TrimSuffix(body, "}") + ",\"nextLink\":" + fmt.Sprintf("%q", next) + "}" }
	cases := map[string]providerCaptureCase{
		"basic": one(envelope(vm([]string{"West Europe"}))),
		"normalization": one(envelope(row("MICROSOFT.Compute", "VirtualMachines", []any{" WEST EUROPE ", "West  Europe", "westeurope", nil}))),
		"global": one(envelope(vm([]string{" Glo bal "}))),
		"location-whitespace": one(envelope(vm([]string{" EAST US ", "West\tEurope", "West\u00a0Europe"}))),
		"key-whitespace": one(envelope(row(" Microsoft.Compute ", " VirtualMachines ", []string{"West Europe"}))),
		"nested-type": one(envelope(row("Microsoft.Sql", "servers/databases", []string{"West Europe"}))),
		"empty": one(envelope()),
		"empty-locations": one(envelope(vm([]string{}))),
		"null-locations": one(envelope(vm(nil))),
		"missing-locations": one("{\"value\":[{\"namespace\":\"Microsoft.Compute\",\"resourceTypes\":[{\"resourceType\":\"virtualMachines\"}]}]}"),
		"missing-namespace": one("{\"value\":[{\"resourceTypes\":[{\"resourceType\":\"virtualMachines\",\"locations\":[\"West Europe\"]}]}]}"),
		"null-namespace": one("{\"value\":[{\"namespace\":null,\"resourceTypes\":[]}]}"),
		"empty-namespace": one(envelope(row("", "virtualMachines", []string{"West Europe"}))),
		"missing-resource-types": one("{\"value\":[{\"namespace\":\"Microsoft.Compute\"}]}"),
		"null-resource-types": one("{\"value\":[{\"namespace\":\"Microsoft.Compute\",\"resourceTypes\":null}]}"),
		"empty-resource-types": one("{\"value\":[{\"namespace\":\"Microsoft.Compute\",\"resourceTypes\":[]}]}"),
		"missing-type": one("{\"value\":[{\"namespace\":\"Microsoft.Compute\",\"resourceTypes\":[{\"locations\":[\"West Europe\"]}]}]}"),
		"empty-type": one(envelope(row("Microsoft.Compute", "", []string{"West Europe"}))),
		"null-provider": one("{\"value\":[null]}"),
		"null-type": one("{\"value\":[{\"namespace\":\"Microsoft.Compute\",\"resourceTypes\":[null]}]}"),
		"null-location": one(envelope(vm([]any{nil, "West Europe"}))),
		"missing-value": one("{}"),
		"null-value": one("{\"value\":null}"),
		"null-envelope": one("null"),
		"wrong-value": one("{\"value\":\"wrong\"}"),
		"wrong-locations": one("{\"value\":[{\"namespace\":\"Microsoft.Compute\",\"resourceTypes\":[{\"resourceType\":\"virtualMachines\",\"locations\":1}]}]}"),
		"malformed": one("{\"value\":"),
		"duplicate-type": one(envelope(vm([]string{"West Europe"}), row("MICROSOFT.COMPUTE", "VIRTUALMACHINES", []string{"East US"}))),
		"duplicate-to-empty": one(envelope(vm([]string{"West Europe"}), row("Microsoft.Compute", "virtualMachines", []string{}))),
		"duplicate-field": one("{\"value\":[{\"namespace\":\"Microsoft.Other\",\"namespace\":\"Microsoft.Compute\",\"resourceTypes\":[{\"resourceType\":\"virtualMachines\",\"locations\":[\"West Europe\"]}]}]}"),
		"case-field-alias": one("{\"value\":[{\"namespace\":\"Microsoft.Compute\",\"Namespace\":\"Microsoft.Other\",\"resourceTypes\":[{\"resourceType\":\"virtualMachines\",\"locations\":[\"West Europe\"]}]}]}"),
		"unicode-namespace": one(envelope(row("Microsoft.\u212a", "widgets", []string{"West Europe"}))),
		"cancelled": {Pages: []providerCapturePage{{200, envelope()}}, Cancelled: true},
		"paged": {Pages: []providerCapturePage{{200, page(envelope(vm([]string{"West Europe"})))}, {200, envelope(row("Microsoft.Storage", "storageAccounts", []string{"East US"}))}}},
		"paged-overwrite": {Pages: []providerCapturePage{{200, page(envelope(vm([]string{"West Europe"})))}, {200, envelope(vm([]string{"East US"}))}}},
		"later-malformed": {Pages: []providerCapturePage{{200, page(envelope(vm([]string{"West Europe"})))}, {200, "{\"value\":"}}},
		"relative-next": one(strings.TrimSuffix(envelope(vm([]string{"West Europe"})), "}") + ",\"nextLink\":" + fmt.Sprintf("%q", providerStart+"&$skiptoken=relative") + "}"),
		"malformed-next": one(strings.TrimSuffix(envelope(vm([]string{"West Europe"})), "}") + ",\"nextLink\":\"https://%invalid\"}"),
		"cycle-stopped": {Pages: []providerCapturePage{{200, strings.TrimSuffix(envelope(vm([]string{"West Europe"})), "}") + ",\"nextLink\":" + fmt.Sprintf("%q", "@BASE@"+providerStart) + "}"}}, CycleLimit: 3},
	}
	cases["later-cancelled"] = providerCaptureCase{Pages: []providerCapturePage{{200, page(envelope(vm([]string{"West Europe"})))}, {200, envelope()}}, CancelAfter: 1}
	for _, status := range []int{400, 403, 404, 405} {
		errorPage := providerCapturePage{status, "{\"error\":{\"code\":\"SyntheticProviderError\",\"message\":\"synthetic\"}}"}
		cases[fmt.Sprintf("http%d", status)] = providerCaptureCase{Pages: []providerCapturePage{errorPage}}
		cases[fmt.Sprintf("later-http%d", status)] = providerCaptureCase{Pages: []providerCapturePage{{200, page(envelope(vm([]string{"West Europe"})))}, errorPage}}
	}

	bootstrap, bootstrapCancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
	fixture.reset(cases["basic"], bootstrapCancel)
	cache, err := fetchAllProviders(bootstrap, providerCaptureCredential{t, providerAudience+"/.default"}, providerSubscription)
	bootstrapCancel()
	if err != nil || cache == nil {
		t.Fatal("provider original-source TLS transport bootstrap failed", err)
	}
	if _, present := cache.Data["microsoft.compute"]["virtualmachines"]["westeurope"]; !present {
		t.Fatal("provider original-source bootstrap cache mismatch")
	}
	results := map[string]providerCaptureResult{}
	for name, c := range cases {
		result := providerCaptureResult{}
		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
		fixture.reset(c, cancel)
		if c.Cancelled {
			cancel()
		}
		func() {
			defer func() {
				if recover() != nil {
					result.Panicked = true
				}
			}()
			var e error
			result.Cache, e = fetchAllProviders(ctx, providerCaptureCredential{t, providerAudience+"/.default"}, providerSubscription)
			result.Failed = e != nil
		}()
		cancel()
		result.Requests, result.RawRequestURIs = fixture.observations()
		ctx, cancel = context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
		fixture.reset(c, cancel)
		if c.Cancelled {
			cancel()
		}
		func() {
			defer func() {
				if recover() != nil {
					result.CallerPanicked = true
				}
			}()
			inventory := &types.ResourceInventory{
				ResourceTypes: map[string]int{"microsoft.compute/virtualmachines": 1},
				ResourceTypesByRegion: map[string]map[string]int{"eastus": {"microsoft.compute/virtualmachines": 1}},
			}
			result.CallerRows = CheckRegionsInParallel(ctx, providerCaptureCredential{t, providerAudience+"/.default"}, []string{"westeurope"}, inventory, providerSubscription, "Synthetic", nil, nil, nil)
		}()
		cancel()
		result.CallerRequests, result.CallerRawRequestURIs = fixture.observations()
		results[name] = result
	}
	write := func(name string, value any) {
		raw, err := json.MarshalIndent(value, "", "  ")
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err = os.MkdirAll(output, 0700); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err = os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(output, name), append(raw, '\n'), 0600); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	write("source-provider-locations-inputs.json", struct {
		SourceBlob, TypesBlob, OptionsBlob, CloudBlob string
		SDKModule, AzcoreModule, SDKProvidersBlob, SDKDefaultTransportBlob string
		ExecutionMode string
		TLSVerificationEnabled bool
		DirectSDKDisableRPRegistration bool
		DirectSDKMaxRetries int
		PublicSDKRequests []string
		Cases map[string]providerCaptureCase
	}{
		"55e59b9e061dd31d27cc3446ad00659bd6961174",
		"f9b61fb74075e5a2297be1b898067b8cb047f9b3",
		"73693e3730f5ed51132a552b79d5e95078721a10",
		"9677ae498c8d22ebbc77a1fe3a47e17579f3c4d5",
		"github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-go/sdk/resourcemanager/resources/armresources v1.2.0",
		"github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-go/sdk/azcore v1.23.1",
		"e1612d16090a9a66c4b2bb9fa5697e7376263992",
		"928e9bf92550dcd83180b7fecff40b7a50fd7ff9",
		"original-source-custom-cloud-loopback-TLS; separate-public-SDK-injected-transport",
		true, true, -1, public.requests, cases,
	})
	write("source-provider-locations-outputs.json", results)
}
